text: レッドは　コイキングを　５００円も　だして　かった！

patterns.name: 〜も (as much as)
patterns.explanation: も after an amount says the speaker finds it a lot. ５００円も = 'a whole ¥500'.

patterns.name: 〜て (linking)
patterns.explanation: The て form joins two actions done one after the other, like 'and'. だして　かった = 'paid and bought'.
